title: Entropy Cache
description: A cache of supplies phases in and out of reality, left behind by a previous dimensional traveler who never made it back. The containers shimmer at their edges, half-dissolved by entropy, but their contents remain intact — frozen in the moment between existence and dissolution. Whoever left these knew this place well.

choices.label: Grab the supplies
choices.description: Snatch coins and trade goods from the cache before it phases out again.

outcomes.text: You time the phase perfectly. Your hands close on heavy coin pouches just as they solidify, pulling them free before the cache flickers out.
The cache phases mid-grab. You get some coins, but one hero's hand is briefly trapped between states of reality — an agonizing experience.
The cache dissolves completely the instant you touch it, releasing a wave of entropic energy that ages everything nearby by a decade in a heartbeat. A few coins survived the dissolution.

choices.label: Collect the entropy residue
choices.description: Harvest the thick layer of entropy residue coating the cache's dissolving containers.

outcomes.text: The residue flakes off in thick sheets, dense with concentrated entropy. A rich haul of crafting material.
You collect a decent amount, but the residue eats through one of your containers. Some is lost, and fumes leave you lightheaded.
The residue is more volatile than expected. It ignites on contact with air, sending corrosive sparks across your party.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.description: Whatever happened to the last traveler, you would rather not share their fate.

outcomes.text: The cache flickers and fades as you watch, the last remnant of someone who thought they could survive this place. A sobering reminder.
